description: Poll a background `grok`, `review`, or `websearch` run, or list recent ones. A finished run replays the original tool result — same text, same metadata, same error flag — so background is a transport, not a second implementation. A run whose worker process has vanished is reported as `abandoned` rather than as still running. Pass `runId` to inspect one run, `waitMs` to block until it finishes, and omit `runId` to list recent runs.

inputSchema.description: Poll a background Grok Build run.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return in list mode. Default 20. Ignored when `runId` is set.

runId.description: Id of a background run to inspect. Omit to list recent runs.

tail.description: Bytes of progress.log to include for a live run. Default 8192.

waitMs.description: Block up to this many milliseconds for the run to finish. Default 0. Ignored in list mode. A timed-out wait is not an error.

inputSchema.title: StatusInput

name: status
